title: Identifying Algorithmic and Domain-Specific Bias in Parliamentary Debate Summarisation

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the fidelity of reconstructed speaker interventions from debate summaries using BERTScore, and analyzing it via beta regression to determine if a speaker's temporal position (speaking order) in the input context affects how accurately their contributions are represented.

Evaluating the fidelity of reconstructed speaker interventions (using BERTScore) across different European Parliament political party groups, analyzed using a beta regression model that calculates marginal mean intervention fidelity while controlling for speaker order.
